bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
test "$(git -C "$root/.worktrees/video-ui-e60b2076" rev-parse HEAD)" = "e60b2076fa5f87a58e7c7b1e3ee3706b06b1e552" || exit 62
docker image inspect create-videobot:video-ui-e60b2076 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo VIDEO_LIVE_POLLER_COUNT_NOT_ONE; exit 71; }
id="${ids[0]}"
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$id")"
files="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$id")"
test -n "$project" && test "$project" != "<no value>" || exit 72
case "$files" in *,*) echo MULTIPLE_COMPOSE_FILES_REQUIRE_REVIEW; exit 73;; esac
test -f "$files" || { echo DEPLOY_COMPOSE_FILE_MISSING; exit 74; }
case "$files" in *compose.videobot.poll.yaml) ;; *) echo DEPLOY_COMPOSE_UNEXPECTED; exit 75;; esac
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$files" config --quiet || { echo VIDEO_COMPOSE_ENV_NOT_READY; exit 76; }
echo VIDEO_DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT=PASS
echo VIDEO_COMPOSE_PROJECT_VERIFIED=PASS
